output.title: New Helm value for disabling HTTP-01 challenges available
output.content: The v1.18.0 upgrade introduces `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` as a new Helm chart value. Your environment already has this key in its values configuration, and cert-manager is deployed via Helm (HelmRelease, Helmfile, ArgoCD Application). Inspect whether you use HTTP-01 ACME challenges; if not, enabling this value improves security by dropping pod creation permissions. Check your current certificate issuers and challenge methods against the release notes before upgrading.
